name: Critical Shift — Facility Greybox
description: Structural skeleton of the Critical Shift site, compacted to 0.6 of the drafting scale in plan. Vertical dimensions and human clearances are unscaled. Greybox: no dressing, no art.

zones.name: YARD
zones.summary: Open surface, the north spine corridor, and the diagonal access run.

zones.name: ARRIVAL
zones.summary: Shift entrance, lobby, lockers and briefing. Player start.

zones.name: MINE
zones.summary: Extraction chambers driven west into the rock mass. Ore vein, dead-end store.

zones.name: HAULAGE
zones.summary: Cart loop between the mine and the crusher. Spurs north and east.

zones.name: CRUSHER
zones.summary: Tipping deck over an open pit. The pit is the way into the service ring.

zones.name: REFINERY
zones.summary: Sorter, processor and dryer on one belt line. Four working elevations.

zones.name: FUEL
zones.summary: Assembly, inspection, containment store. Its roof watches the compliance road.

zones.name: REACTOR
zones.summary: Compact four-door workroom. Core and all time-critical controls are one short loop.

zones.name: CONTROL
zones.summary: East of the reactor, raised, looking in through the overlook windows.

zones.name: COOLING
zones.summary: Sunk south-east of the reactor. Open cut on its north side, drains west.

zones.name: STORAGE
zones.summary: Waste yard and bulk store, with a stair down into the service ring.

zones.name: MEDICAL
zones.summary: Reanimation and decontamination, on the southern loop.

zones.name: MAINTENANCE
zones.summary: Service ring under the site. Hidden flanking access to almost everywhere.

zones.name: COMPLIANCE
zones.summary: Road and dock north of the plant, then one long corridor to the reactor door.

routes.name: Primary production flow
routes.notes: Mine → haulage → crusher → refinery → fuel → reactor.

routes.name: Main worker access
routes.notes: Arrival, S1 behind the production row, then the diagonal into the reactor.

routes.name: Cart line
routes.notes: Loop, north spur to the crusher, east spur onto the shared diagonal.

routes.name: S1 — north spine
routes.notes: Straight behind crusher, refinery and fuel. Never touches the cart line.

routes.name: S2 — haulage to storage
routes.notes: Out of the cart hall onto the southern loop without crossing the diagonal.

routes.name: S3 — medical to cooling
routes.notes: Reaches the cooling lid without entering the reactor hall at all.

routes.name: Maintenance ring
routes.notes: A closed loop one level down. Four ways in, none of them overlooked.

routes.name: Compliance approach
routes.notes: Road, dock, and one straight line past fuel to the reactor north door.
